scope: Independent actual-source and focused-test review of the isolated simulator signing driver and v2-to-v2 regeneration path; no build/install/runtime acceptance.

findings.buildDriver: The private Release driver now requests Xcode simulator ad-hoc signing with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES and CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=-, retaining the existing destination, arm64 selection, smoke readiness checks, private paths and private log. It does not modify product or native project settings.
findings.v2Regeneration: Requires completed_bound and validates the exact v2 schema/tool version, admitted ref/content, exact source/tool/five-patch key maps, build hashes, detached HEAD and exact working-tree patch scope before mutation. It restores only two tracked sources, removes only three helpers, then reapplies with a distinct fresh nonce into a new external binding; old binding remains intact.
findings.preMutationTests: Tests cover identical nonce, invalid outcome, existing output, stale ref/content/source/build binding, and changed/missing/extra/symlink patch paths before mutation.
findings.testCoverageGap: The generated-directory exact-name guard is present, but the extra-entry test is caught earlier by Git status and does not exercise an ignored extra file that bypasses status. No source defect observed; narrow branch coverage remains.
findings.causalLimit: Signing metadata mismatch justifies artifact correction but does not prove the cause of the prior local logout-control read failure. The old run did not reach profile storage or Q13 resume; the safe category remains corrupt versus unavailable.
findings.runtimeGap: No corrected Release artifact has yet been built/inspected/installed/run as part of this review. Verify bundle ID, code-signature Identifier, ad-hoc/no-linker flags, and strict codesign success before any install.

notClaimed: Signing caused the prior SecureStore/Keychain read failure
Q13 resume reached in the prior Release run
